decision.summary: The Federal Reserve decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 4-1/4 to 4-1/2 percent.

changes.quote: The unemployment rate has stabilized at a low level in recent months, and labor market conditions remain solid.
changes.explanation: The Committee updated its view to state that the labor market has stabilized and remains solid.
The Committee shortened its description of inflation, removing the mention of prior progress.

changes.quote: In support of its goals, the Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 4-1/4 to 4-1/2 percent.
changes.explanation: The Fed shifted its action from cutting rates to holding them steady.

tone_quotes.quote: Recent indicators suggest that economic activity has continued to expand at a solid pace.

In considering the extent and timing of additional adjustments to the target range for the federal funds rate, the Committee will carefully assess incoming data, the evolving outlook, and the balance of risks.

for_you.text: Card rates should not move on this decision; a $5,000 balance at about 21.76% APR costs about $90.67 a month in interest.

Mortgages track the 10-year Treasury, not the fed funds rate. The 10-year was 4.55% and moved 0 bp on the day; if that move passed through, the payment on a new $300,000 30-year loan at 7.04% would not change.
Savings yields should stay roughly where they are, since the Fed held rates.
Unemployment was 4.1%, and employers added an average of 135k jobs a month over the prior 3 months.

for_country.text: CPI inflation was 2.9% over the past year (December 2024); core PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred gauge, was 2.9%, against a 2% goal.
Real GDP grew at a 2.4% annualized pace in the latest reported quarter.
The 2-year Treasury yield, the most Fed-sensitive market rate, moved +2 bp on day, and the S&P 500 moved -0.47%.
The broad trade-weighted dollar moved 0.05% on the day.

whats_next: The statement signals that the Committee will carefully assess incoming data and the evolving outlook before making any future adjustments. As an educational note, the forecast model gave the next meeting: hold 91%, cut 9%, hike 0%.
